title: What Happens If You Don't Sleep For 7 Days?
sources: Harvard Medical School, Division of Sleep Medicine (Sleep deprivation cognitive deficits)
NIH / Science (Glymphatic waste clearance during deep sleep)
CDC (Sleep loss effects on reaction time and immune system)

lines.text: What would actually happen to your body if you didn't sleep for seven whole days?
lines.caps: What happens | if you *don't sleep | for *seven days?

lines.text: Well, after twenty-four hours without sleep,
your brain performs like you're legally drunk,
as your reaction time slows down by nearly fifty percent.
By day two, your body begins forcing microsleeps,
brief lapses where your brain literally shuts off for seconds while your eyes are still wide open.
By day three, toxic waste proteins build up inside your head,
because your brain can only flush toxins while you're deeply asleep.
lines.caps: brain flushes toxins | *only in deep sleep.

lines.text: By day five, intense hallucinations kick in,
as dream states bleed directly into your waking reality.
And by day seven, your immune system crashes,
and your body simply collapses from exhaustion.
